title: Psychology Facts
hook: Three mind traps that fool you every day.
facts: *One*: confirmation bias. You favor evidence that agrees with you.
*Two*: the sunk cost trap. You keep going because you already paid.
*Three*: hindsight bias. After the fact, you swear you knew it.
Fischhoff showed this in 1975, and it fooled almost everyone.
outro: Which trap fooled you this week?
